name: AWS
attack_surface: EC2 metadata, IAM instance profiles, public S3 buckets, Lambda function policies
common_misconfigurations: Missing source IP constraints on security groups
validation_methods: Test credentials using aws sts get-caller-identity
Check bucket access using aws s3 ls
evidence_requirements: Raw terminal output showing caller identity or listing success
false_positive_indicators: Invalid or disabled credentials in log traces
Buckets that are readable but contain no sensitive user files
reporting_guidance: Focus on data exposure or credential leaks leading to execution privileges.
